root_cause.text: The `link_id` extracted from the ML Reconfiguration element (via `control & 0x000f`) was not bounds-checked against `IEEE80211_MLD_MAX_NUM_LINKS` before being used as an index into the `link_removal_timeout[]` array (or as a bit shift for `removed_links`), allowing an out-of-bounds write when `link_id` equals 15.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that `link_removal_timeout[]` has `IEEE80211_MLD_MAX_NUM_LINKS` (15) elements and that a `link_id` of 15 is out-of-bounds, and the patch adds a `if (link_id >= IEEE80211_MLD_MAX_NUM_LINKS) continue;` guard to skip such invalid subelements.
